nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the Express/Prisma backend: a 'base' stage installs dependencies, generates the Prisma client and compiles TypeScript, while a slim 'runner' stage copies the built dist plus node_modules and runs the production server on port 5000.

nodes.name: base
nodes.summary: Builder stage that runs npm ci, copies prisma/tsconfig/src, then executes 'prisma generate' and 'npm run build' to produce the compiled dist output consumed by the runtime stage.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Production runtime stage that copies build artifacts from the base stage, sets NODE_ENV=production, exposes port 5000 and starts the server via 'node dist/server.js'.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that keeps node_modules, dist, log files and the .env secrets out of the image build context for the backend Dockerfile.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the Next.js frontend: installs dependencies, builds the app, and produces a minimal production runner image serving the standalone server on port 3000.

nodes.name: deps
nodes.summary: First build stage based on node:20-bookworm-slim that copies package manifests and runs npm ci to install dependencies in an isolated layer.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Build stage extending deps that injects the NEXT_PUBLIC_OUTBOUND_API_BASE build arg, copies the source tree, and runs the Next.js production build.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Final production stage on node:20-bookworm-slim that copies the built standalone server, public, and static assets, exposes port 3000, and launches the Next.js server.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list for the frontend, omitting files from the image build to keep the build context small and avoid leaking local artifacts.

GitHub Actions CI workflow named "CI". Triggers on pushes to the main/master branches and on all pull requests. Defines a single "build" job running on ubuntu-latest that checks out the repo, sets up Node.js 20 with npm caching keyed on backend/ and frontend/ package-lock.json, installs backend and frontend dependencies via npm ci, and builds both the backend (npm run build:backend) and frontend (npm run build:frontend).
